an8.23:5.1: “Here, sir, I robed up in the morning and, taking my bowl and robe, went to the home of the householder Hatthaka of Āḷavī, where I sat down on the seat spread out.
an8.23:5.2: Then Hatthaka of Āḷavī, sir, came up to me, bowed, and sat down to one side.
an8.23:5.3: Seated to one side, I, sir, said this to Hatthaka of Āḷavī:
an8.23:5.4: ‘Respectable sir, the Buddha declared that you have seven amazing and incredible qualities.
an8.23:5.13: The Buddha declared that you possess these seven amazing and incredible qualities.’
an8.23:6.1: Having spoken thus, sir, Hatthaka said this to me:
an8.23:6.2: ‘But sir, I trust that no white-clothed lay people were present?’
an8.23:6.3: ‘No, there weren’t any white-clothed lay people present.’
an8.23:6.4: ‘That’s good, sir, that there were no white-clothed lay people here.’”
